name: Pork and Potato Breakfast Burrito
method: Cut the potatoes into small chunks and microwave for 4 minutes, then fry in the oil over a medium-high heat for 12 minutes with the paprika, salt and pepper until crisp. Tip out and keep warm.
In the same pan cook the pork mince for 5 minutes, breaking it up, until browned and cooked through. Stir in the tomato puree and set aside, then wipe the pan.
Whisk the eggs with salt and pepper. Melt the butter over a low heat, add the eggs and stir gently for 3 minutes, taking the pan off the heat just before they look done.
Warm the wrap, spread with the BBQ sauce, then layer on the potatoes, eggs, pork and grated cheddar. Fold in the sides and roll up tightly.
Brown the burrito in the pan for 2 minutes each side, rest for 5 minutes, then cut in half and serve.
